# Tempo

> Tempo is a comprehensive Jira-native platform for strategic portfolio management, project planning, resource allocation, and delivery intelligence.

Tempo provides integrated solutions for enterprise teams managing complex portfolios, including SPM, capacity planning, time tracking, and AI-powered adaptive planning capabilities. The platform extends Jira with advanced portfolio management, financial tracking, and strategic roadmapping features.

## Key Topics

- Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)
- Jira Integration
- Portfolio Management
- Resource Planning
- Capacity Planning
- Project Management
- Time Tracking
- Resource Allocation
- Adaptive Planning
- Tempo Collections
- BigQuery Connector
- Strategic Roadmaps
- Delivery Intelligence
- Enterprise PPM
- Financial Management

## Core Products & Platforms

- [Project, Product, & Portfolio Management Software for Jira](https://www.tempo.io): Tempo homepage: comprehensive Jira solutions for project, product, and portfolio management.
- [Strategic Portfolio Management for Jira](https://www.tempo.io/platform/strategic-portfolio-management): Tempo's Strategic Portfolio Management platform for Jira with roadmapping and team alignment.
- [SPM | Tempo](https://www.tempo.io/spm): Tempo's Strategic Portfolio Management solution overview and resources.
- [Adaptive Planner EAP](https://www.tempo.io/adaptive-planner-insights-eap): Early Access Program for Tempo's AI-powered Adaptive Planner for resource allocation.
- [Integrate Jira with BigQuery](https://www.tempo.io/products/bigquery-connector-for-jira): Tempo's BigQuery Connector: no-code Jira data export and analytics integration.
